title: Initiative Plan
description: Output contract for the BMAD Scrum Master initiative planner. apply-plan.sh consumes this to create the epic + sub-issue DAG.

source_discussion.description: Discussion number this plan was generated from.

untracked_prerequisites.description: Prerequisites that are NOT GitHub issues (a discussion, an external dependency). Rendered as an 'Untracked prerequisites' checklist on the epic body. For prereqs that ARE issues, use a story's blocked_by_existing_issues instead.

items.description: A story in the BMAD create-story template shape (Story / AC / Tasks-Subtasks / Dev Notes). apply-plan.sh renders the issue body in that order.

id.description: Local 1-based index, unique within the plan. Used only to express blocked_by edges.

user_story.description: BMAD story statement: As a {role}, I want {action}, so that {benefit}.

acceptance_criteria.description: Numbered, testable outcomes. Tasks reference these by 1-based index.

tasks.description: BMAD Tasks / Subtasks breakdown; each task cites the AC indices it satisfies.

dev_notes.description: BMAD Dev Notes: architecture patterns/constraints, source-tree components to touch, testing standards. The implementer (dev-lead) sees ONLY the story, so ground it here.

project_structure_notes.description: Alignment with the repo's structure; any conflicts/variances with rationale.

target_surface.description: Files/scripts/workflows the implementer will likely touch.

blocked_by.description: Local story ids this story depends on.

blocked_by_existing_issues.description: Existing repo issue numbers this story depends on (e.g. a prerequisite bug).

hands_off.description: True => a human must do this; never auto-released to dev-lead.

open_questions.description: Things the planner could not resolve from context; surfaced for the human reviewer. A plain string is advisory (non-blocking). An object flagged `blocking:true` is plan-blocking: apply-plan.sh creates NO issues and posts the questions back to the source discussion instead (see #682).

blocking.description: True => this question must be answered before the idea is plannable; halts materialization.

affected_story_ids.description: Local story ids this open question concerns. Set when a critic finding (see prompts/plan-review.md) could not be folded back into the plan and was routed here by route-findings.sh, so the question names which stories it gates. Empty/absent for epic- or plan-level questions.

proposed_story.description: A whole story the plan is missing, surfaced by a plan-critic finding whose resolution is 'add story X' (#706). Until a maintainer sets `accepted:true` it gates like any blocking open_question; on acceptance apply-plan.sh materializes it as a sub-issue of the epic (title + acceptance-criteria scaffold), rather than dropping it into prose.

acceptance_criteria.description: Numbered, testable outcomes for the proposed story.

proposed_blocked_by.description: Existing repo issue number that the proposed_story gates (blocks). On acceptance apply-plan.sh wires a NATIVE `<proposed_blocked_by> blocked_by <new sub-issue>` edge (the new story must land first). Worked example: #587 blocked_by the two materialized #581 stories (#706).

accepted.description: Maintainer acceptance marker (#706). When true, the finding no longer gates and apply-plan.sh materializes its proposed_story + proposed_blocked_by edge. NEVER set automatically — the human gate: the epic stays inert until a maintainer reviews and accepts.
